name: Love
overview: Scripture reveals love as a divine command rooted in God's character and faithful mercy toward those who love Him and keep His commandments, as seen in Exodus 20:6. The call to love extends to neighbors and even strangers, emphasizing impartial and active care within the community, as Leviticus 19:18 and 19:34 instruct. This love is not merely emotional but a committed obedience to God’s law and a reflection of His steadfast mercy, shaping relationships within families, the church, and society.
